name: Jumoku Hime
source:
While picking fruit and herb in a forest with his maid, our guy got hit on the head and tied under a sacred tree. When his secretary/bodyguard/wife found him, he had lost some of past two months memory. His first assassin suspects are his secretary and three maids. Later on, he found that either there is an assassin hiding in the forest or something strange is going on. Can he find out what in 10 days while loving one of the girls?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
主人公和女仆在森林里采摘水果与药草时，被人击中头部，并被绑在一棵神树下。秘书兼保镖兼妻子找到他时，他已经失去了过去两个月的一部分记忆。最先被怀疑的刺客是他的秘书和三名女仆。后来，他发现要么有刺客藏在森林里，要么就是某种诡异的事情正在发生。他能否在十天内查明真相，同时爱上其中一名女孩？

[引自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
